limits.limit: Bend: segments between anchors are joined with a 10 ms crossfade at each anchor (where the two sides differ in phase the level can dip briefly), ratio 0.25..4 per segment, stereo shares one map; listening review is a native gate
restores the original material recorded on the first warp
Listen: only while the transport is stopped and not recording; never saved; explicit mutes still win
automation lanes only; the clip-gain envelope has its own command (clip.gain_draw)
clip-gain envelope in dB (−144..+36) of one clip
keypad vs top-row keys are not distinguished by the UI toolkit (B03); physical keypad use is a native gate

Loop Playback loops the stored loop range when one is set, else the edit selection; Loop Record records over the edit selection (loop.select copies the loop range into it); locators cannot move while recording
takes are placed from backend capture timestamps; loop record and punch use the documented scheduler
no compressed export formats; monitor controls never reach a bounce
hardware monitoring means the interface mixes the input; the app cannot verify the interface's own mix

hosted plugins run in-process by default (no crash containment); the opt-in `sandbox:<id>` mode runs a plugin out of process with one block of added latency and no native editor (E03); scanning is isolated

grounded rules by default; an optional LOCAL language model server (none ships; loopback only) may propose actions that are validated before preview; speech is a built-in enrolled-phrase recognizer (quiet rooms; not dictation) and a robotic formant voice on the monitor output only; plans run only as validated commands at the current revision
meters follow BS.1770-4 / R128 / Tech 3342 and are checked against analytic test signals (E07), not certified; the reference is monitor-only
autosave keeps rolling validated generations; power-loss guarantees are unverified (E02)

note: Generated from the command registry, shortcut tables, control.rs and mcp.rs of this source tree. Status/risk/undo come from the registry; risk is the registry's prefix rule, not a guarantee. Chords use Windows/Linux key names (Cmd = Ctrl); [unverified] marks Studio One-style rows not checked against that product's manual.
